(Japanese: ユウタ Yūta) is a character from the Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon! manga.

==History==
Yuta appeared in Pokémon Hot Springs, Hot-Hot Battle, where he caught an in the hot spring where Shu was relaxing. When the duo attempted to take over the hot springs, he attempted to battle Shu using . It took a majority of Shu's team to take them on, until 's placed Magmar in a hot spring of its own. After Magmar found the hot springs, Yuta apologized for his actions and was subsequently chased by Magmar.
